messages:
anna_docs: quick sync — I opened a docs PR that tries to consolidate the schema examples and slim down the tool examples. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 Please check for breaking changes for SDK snippet consumers.
ben_platform: looked — small nits, but two big concerns: (1) call/response envelope changed shape, need migration note; (2) embedded examples reference old pkg import path.
carlos_eng: can you paste the exact diff for the envelope? worried about runtime change for Dedicated users.
anna_docs: pasted diff:
```
Old: {"tool": {"name": "xx", "args": {...}}}
New: {"invoke": {"target": "xx", "payload": {...}}}
```
leah_research: hmm that's a breaking rename. Prefer adding compatibility shim in SDKs first, then switch docs. Otherwise customers will copy-paste and break.
ben_platform: agree. Plan: add 'compat envelope' note and keep examples showing both shapes. Add deprecation callout with timeline.
anna_docs: ack. I'll add a migration section and two example snippets (legacy + new). Anyone want to own the SDK PR that adds the shim?
carlos_eng: I can pick the shim up. ETA EOD friday.
anna_docs: perfect. Also found 3 dead links in the parsing patterns page — will fix in this PR.
ci-bot: build passed for docs PR #4321 :white_check_mark:
ben_platform: also cc @leah_research on guardrail phrasing: we should avoid prescriptive language like "must" for any model output that can be heuristically parsed.
leah_research: noted. I'll suggest softer wording and add an example for fallback parsing using regex + json fallback.
anna_docs: draft fallback snippet:
```
if try_parse_json(out):
  use_json()
else:
  parse_with_regex(out)
```
ben_platform: love it. Could we also add a sample trace of a wrong parse and how the fallback recovers? helps SRE.
anna_docs: yep adding small trace and a link to the eval that covers this.
carlos_eng: one more: update the SDK import paths in all examples to the modular package (redwood.infer.sdk.call) — I have a script to replace.
anna_docs: pls run script and push changes to my branch, will review.
ben_platform: merge checklist: compat note, example pair, fallback snippet, link fixes, ci green. If all done we can merge tomorrow morning.
anna_docs: thanks team :party_parrot:
